message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data; the code proceeds directly to DataLoader and model inference without validating input structure or content.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code reads data from a local filesystem path (dataset_root_dir) with no checksum verification, signature validation, or authenticated download from any remote source.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is present anywhere in the data-flow path shown.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads checkpoints via a user-supplied --resume_path argument with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading the serialized model.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any robustness stress-testing in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no explicit isolation enforcement of a held-out test set from training data, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: Inputs are passed directly through DataLoader and input_transform() to the model with no shape, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: VLAD encodings and recall scores are used directly without any NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks on the model outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a visual place recognition (image-based) pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
